literal_meaning: ব্রাহ্মণের গুণ বা বৈশিষ্ট্য (বামণ + ঐ সূচক)
figurative_meaning_en: Pride in Brahmin identity, boasting or arrogance
example_sentences_in_english: Everyone laughs at his Brahmin pride.
The villager's boasting about his Brahmin status is unbearable.
history: References the folkloric figure Shunyabhattacharya, symbolizing empty or pretentious Brahmin pride in Bengali proverbs and stories.
note: Idiom critiques caste-based superiority in traditional Bengali society.
